identitySignals: Council's own website (btcalameda.org) names it 'Building and Construction Trades Council of Alameda County', a coalition of 28 affiliated construction unions, matching the agenda name

OUSD's own legislative record (ousd.legistar.com File 23-2433) describes a tentative agreement between the District and the Building and Construction Trades Council of Alameda County (BCTC) for District skilled trade workers, matching the agenda's collective bargaining agreement item
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists a 501(c)(5) labor organization in Oakland, CA (Alameda County BCTC), EIN 94-0272624, consistent with the council being based in Alameda County
research.notes: Labor union council (IRS 501(c)(5)); orgType set to 'other'. ProPublica lists the legal name under the AFL-CIO parent's name, so legal name is taken from the council's website. Phone and street address were not confirmed on a fetchable official page and are left null.

profile.legalName: Building and Construction Trades Council of Alameda County
profile.summary: A labor council made up of 28 affiliated unions that represent workers in the construction trades in Alameda County, California. It runs labor-management apprenticeship programs and works with a nonprofit partner to train skilled construction workers.

sources.title: Building and Construction Trades Council of Alameda County
Alameda County BCTC - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The council's own site confirms the name, the 28-affiliated-union coalition, the apprenticeship programs, the nonprofit partner (CTWI) and the btca@ business email. ProPublica confirms the EIN, a 501(c)(5) status and an Oakland location, which fits the collective bargaining agreement item in the OUSD record.
